reasons.wiki_unavailable: Monitoring shows HTTP 503 for every user, strong direct evidence the wiki is unavailable now.
reasons.handling_mode: No user instructions or domain context define an objective, so the needed output kind is undetermined; spread over all declared options with a slight lean to on-call routing for a full-user outage.
reasons.user_impact: Full wiki outage for all staff is a noticeable disruption, but unknown work dependency depth leaves real weight on major and some on minor.
